hooks.name: Read Docs Before Task
hooks.description: Before starting a spec task, read the container development documentation and lessons learned to understand constraints and best practices for building containers on Cradlepoint NCOS routers.

action.prompt:
Before starting this task, read the following documentation files to understand the constraints and best practices for building containers on Cradlepoint NCOS routers:
1. docs/container-development-guide.md
2. docs/ncos-sdk-reference.md
3. docs/memory-resources.md
4. .kiro/steering/lessons-learned.md

Apply the knowledge from these docs and any lessons learned to the task you are about to execute.
